title: Set up a conversion rule
text: A conversion rule tells the system how one product becomes another, such as 1 case becoming 24 pieces. Saving the rule does not move stock yet.
steps: Open Sidebar > Inventory, then Stock Conversion.
Click Add Conversion.
Choose the source product on the left and the target product on the right.
Type how many target units come from one source unit. Check the preview line.
Keep Active turned on, then click Save.

title: Run a conversion
text: A conversion removes stock from the source product and adds it to the target product right away. The oldest batch is used first.
steps: Open Sidebar > Inventory, then Stock Conversion.
Find the rule, then click the arrow at the end of the row and choose Convert.
Type the quantity to convert. The screen shows what you will receive and the stock before and after.
Add a note if needed.
Click Confirm. Stock moves immediately.

title: Copy a rule to other branches
text: Each branch has its own conversion rules. The Apply to Other Branches option lets you copy the same rule to the branches you choose.
steps: Open Sidebar > Inventory, then Stock Conversion.
Click Add Conversion or edit an existing rule.
Under Apply to Other Branches, click the branches you want to copy it to.
Click Save. Any branch without both products is skipped.

title: See past conversions
text: Conversion History lists every run of a rule. Date, reference, amounts on both sides, who did it, and the note.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Stock Conversion.
Click the arrow at the end of the rule row, then Conversion History.
Scroll down to load older runs.
Need the stock side? Open Stock History on the product. Look for a reference starting with SC.

title: Pause, change, or remove a rule
text: Turn Active off to pause a rule. A rule that has been used cannot be deleted. It becomes Inactive instead.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Stock Conversion.
Click the arrow at the end of the rule row, then Edit.
Change the products, unit names, or amount. Or switch Active off.
Click Save. Past conversions do not change.
To remove an unused rule, pick Delete from the same menu.

title: Convert will not run
text: Convert is blocked when the rule is Inactive, the source has too little stock, or you are on All Branches.
steps: If the row says Inactive, click Edit and switch Active on.
Check the source on-hand quantity. Convert that amount or less.
